vb_textbox.text: Good luck trying to establish a pattern. Four different gnomes: two species which have elongated tops (blue and greeny-brown) and two with flat tops (red and grey). I had consistently pretty good luck with the elongated blues, and the grey flats seemed to give the lowest return. The important thing to note is that it fluctuates - I kept spamming the blues, and eventually I no longer had them as a choice. Maybe it's possible to 'exhaust' them? Also, near the end, I generally just had diminished returns. I ended on around ~800 or so. Good luck
